{{Quote|They took out an entire security detail and scuttled one of our new starships.|[[Hera Syndulla]]|<ref name="Part One" />}}
The '''''Defender''-class cruiser''' was a type of [[cruiser]] manufactured by [[Mon Calamari Shipyards]] in the [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Galactic Civil War]] in the [[New Republic Era]] by [[9 ABY]]. At that [[time]], the cruiser was considered new and was deployed in numbers by the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]] in several roles, including patrol, [[prisoner]] [[transport]], and combat, such as during the [[Fenril crisis]]. Multiple ships comprised the [[Hera Syndulla's fleet|New Republic fleet]] led by [[General]] [[Hera Syndulla]], while others were stationed above [[Corellia]].

One ship, the ''[[Vesper]]'', was [[Attack on the Vesper|attacked]] by [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] loyal to [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Magistrate]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]], setting off a chain of events that brought the return of [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] from a [[far galaxy]]. Another ship of the class, the ''[[Dawnbringer]]'', led two other ''Defender''-class cruisers to detain Syndulla during an [[incident on Seatos]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Defender''-class cruiser<ref name="Comprehensive" /> was a model of [[cruiser]] manufactured by [[Mon Calamari Shipyards]]. The ship had a long off-white [[hull]] with [[Color|blue]] trim and the [[Sigil of the New Republic]] on the port and starboard. Past the midsection of the ship, the hull slenderized before expanding at the aft section, which hosted the ship's cluster of eleven [[sublight engine]]s, including three large units at the center. This aft section hosted a dorsal tower with [[antenna]] and protected by four [[turbolaser]] [[turret]]s. The aft section's ventral side held a fin.<ref name="Part One" />

[[File:Ahsoka_Part_One_Vesper_Engines.png|thumb|left|250px|Aft view of a ''Defender''-class cruiser]]
The [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] was located on the prow of the [[cruiser]] beneath a canopy. The bridge had multiple windows to provide a wide field of vision and was equipped with multiple control stations, with the [[commanding officer]] situated on a rotating command chair with a central console. The bridge was equipped with communication and navigation stations, with the door located at the rear of the bridge that led to a [[turbolift]]. The prow section had a mid-ridge that horizontally traversed the sides of the ship until reaching the craft's four [[hangar]]s, two on each side. The hangars hosted a variety of maintenance equipment and had a capacity for at least several [[starfighter]]s. The cruiser had multiple white hallways leading to various parts of the ship, including the detention level which had several holding cells. When a security alert was triggered, an alarm rang out with flashing red lights.<ref name="Part One" />

==Role==
The ''Defender''-class cruiser was a warship that could be used as a high-level [[prisoner]] [[transport]],<ref name="Part One" /> and performed patrols and other missions.<ref name="Comprehensive" />

==History==
The ''Defender''-class cruiser was built at the start of the New Republic as part of a new fleet built for defense.<ref name="Dawnbringer DB">{{Databank|the-dawnbringer|The Dawnbringer}}</ref> During the [[Fenril crisis]], a ''Defender''-class accompanied a group of New Republic vessels led by [[Envoy|Special Envoy]] [[Kith Alaytia]] over [[Nagi]] to combat [[Reyna Oskure]]'s [[Nagai]] forces before they detonated as a trap.<ref name="SW9" />

[[File:NR-Transports-Ahsoka-Trailer.png|thumb|right|280px|The ''Dawnbringer'' and other cruisers arriving above Seatos.]]
One ship, the ''[[Vesper]]'', was considered new by the [[time]] it was [[Attack on the Vesper|attacked]] by two [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] [[Force-sensitive|Force users]], [[Baylan Skoll]] and his apprentice [[Shin Hati]]. The ''Vesper'', commanded by [[Captain]] [[Hayle]], was transporting [[Morgan Elsbeth]], an Imperial [[warlord]], to face New Republic justice. While en route to rendezvous with the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser|Heavy Star Cruiser]] ''[[Home One]]'' in [[Sector G-38]], the ''Vesper'' instead encountered [[Baylan's shuttle|Baylan and Shin's ''Eta''-class shuttle]] and allowed it to dock in one of its four hangars.<ref name="Part One" />

Although Captain Hayle called Skoll's bluff that they were [[Jedi]] and deduced that they were Imperial sympathizers, Skoll and his apprentice Hati attacked the New Republic security detail, [[Death|killing]] Hayle, neutralizing the bridge, and rescuing Elsbeth. The ''Vesper'' was subsequently scuttled and destroyed, though a number of survivors were rescued by ''Home One'' when it arrived. The former Jedi [[Ahsoka Tano]] travelled to meet with [[General]] [[Hera Syndulla]] aboard ''Home One'' to discuss the attack and continue their [[Quest to find Ezra Bridger|search for Ezra Bridger and Grand Admiral Thrawn]].<ref name="Part One" />

[[File:Defender-Cruisers-Purrgil.png|thumb|260px|left|The purrgil depart Seatos and travel past the ''Defender''-class cruisers sent to detain Syndulla.]]
As part of the search and investigation, Syndulla and Tano rendezvoused on [[Corellia]], which at the time of their arrival had at least eight New Republic Cruisers in [[orbit]], with some docked with an orbital [[space station]].<ref name="Part Two">{{Ahsoka|Part Two: Toil and Trouble}}</ref> While Tano, the [[droid]] [[Huyang]], and Tano's apprentice, the [[Mandalorian]] [[Sabine Wren]] tracked an [[Transport CT-O5|Imperial transport]] from Corellia to the [[Denab system]], ''Home One'' had joined with a [[fleet]] consisting of at least five New Republic Cruisers, four [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]]s, seven [[CR90 corvette]]s, and seven [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvettes]].<ref name="Part Three">{{Ahsoka|Part Three: Time to Fly}}</ref>

{{Expandsect}}
A fleet comprising of three ''Defender''-class cruisers, including the ''[[Dawnbringer]]'', under the command of Captain [[Girard]] were sent to [[Seatos]] to bring back Syndulla, Captain [[Carson Teva]] and their [[squadron]] back to [[Coruscant]] where the [[Senate Oversight Committee]] would determine whether or not Syndulla's command be permanently suspended.<ref name="Part Five">{{Ahsoka|Part Five: Shadow Warrior}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ISD-RC-Concepts.png|thumb|right|230px|The cruiser is almost physically identical to the Rebel Cruiser concept art drawn by Joe Johnston.]]
The cruiser appeared in the live-action web-TV series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'' in [[2023]]. It was first seen in the teaser trailer for the series that was released during [[Celebration Europe (2023)|Celebration Europe 2023]],<ref name="Teaser Trailer">{{SWYouTube|HnzNZ0Mdx4I|Ahsoka | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/ahsoka-teaser-trailer}}</ref> and was described as a transport in the audio description of the trailer on [[Disney+]] when it was available.<ref name="Audio">''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'' {{AD|Disney+}} {{C|No longer available}}</ref> The starship was identified as the ''Defender''-class cruiser in ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'', a reference book released in [[2024]].<ref name="Comprehensive" />
[[File:New_Republic_cruiser_concept_art.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Concept art for the New Republic cruiser designed by Benjamin Last.]]
[[Benjamin Last]] revealed concept art and name for the craft, the New Republic Cruiser, on his social media on [[August 29]], [[2023]], which was previously previewed at ComicCon 2023, and received design direction by [[Doug Chiang]].<ref name="Tweet 1">{{Twitter|BenjaminJLast|status/1696718601007567152|[[Benjamin Last]]|quote=New Republic Cruiser I designed for Star Wars: Ahsoka. Had a blast designing for this show with an amazing team at @Lucasfilm. This design sketch was previewed at ComicCon. Design Direction Doug Chiang #StarWars #Ahsoka|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/iMdjF}}</ref> Last confirmed that the basis of the design was based off of<ref name="Tweet 2">{{Twitter|BenjaminJLast|status/1697207678907637769|[[Benjamin Last]]|quote=Thanks! and yes - when designing for Star Wars, we look to the aesthetic foundations setup by Ralph Mcquarrie, Joe Johnston and Doug Chiang. This helps maintain a visual design amongst ships - most notably in the Imperial / First order ships.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/8w75r}}</ref> the [[MC30c frigate|MC30C frigate]],<ref name="Tweet 3">{{Twitter|TalkingMink|status/1697157466654638423|Matthew Hankin|quote=It's a beauty and it certainly feels like something the NR would be churning out as it doesn't look too complex or specialised. I have to ask was there inspiration from the MC-30? And for my own peace of mind how long is it?|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/RY1HY}}</ref> and that when they always look to the aesthetic foundations laid by [[Joe Johnston]], [[Ralph McQuarrie]], and Doug Chiang.<ref name="Tweet 2" />

The design of the cruiser is similar in physical appearance to the "Rebel Cruiser" concept art drawn by Joe Johnston for [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="ROTJ Sketchbook">''[[Return of the Jedi Sketchbook]]''</ref> which itself is similar to the design that eventually became the basis for the MC30c frigate.<ref name="Art of ROTJ">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>
